units.source_text: 在节日甚多的京都，十月二十二日的时代节，

en.t: In Kyoto, a city with many festivals, the Jidai Festival on October 22,

units.source_text: 同上贺茂神社、下贺茂神社举办的葵节、祇园节一起，被公认为三大节日。

en.t: is recognized as one of the three great festivals, together with the Aoi Festival held by Kamigamo Shrine and Shimogamo Shrine, and the Gion Festival.

units.source_text: 它虽然是平安神宫的祭祀，

en.t: Although it is a ritual of Heian Shrine,

units.source_text: 仪仗队却是从京都御所出发的。

en.t: the ceremonial procession sets out from the Kyoto Imperial Palace.
